scope: one isolated run of the ec00 ingress fixture behind the actual Cilium Gateway gateway/internal (listener https, wildcard apps TLS) with verified TLS from the workstation; namespace created and deleted for the run

source.note: remote_checks.py trust-store fix in the same commit as this receipt; the workload image is unaffected by it

dial.tls: verified against the host trust bundle; SNI and certificate name = route hostname

keys: fresh client-side Ed25519 pair per run; only the public half mounted; private half deleted after each run

runs.result: 108 cases, 0 invariant failures; superseded: the raw HTTP/1.1 header probe failed client-side (cadata TypeError on a non-ASCII host CA bundle), fixed before run 2
108 cases: 100 security assertions passed, 8 observation-only, 0 invariant failures

observations: x-request-id is preserved end to end (the Gateway marks LAN clients x-envoy-internal and does not regenerate it); when absent, the Gateway adds one, plus x-forwarded-for, x-forwarded-proto and x-envoy-internal.

Repeated x-vuoro-identity arrives as two separate headers; repeated x-request-id arrives joined into one comma-separated value. Both shapes are refused (identity) with no owner effect on all four arms.
HTTP and Connect routes reach the backend as HTTP/1.1 even when the client negotiates HTTP/2; only the gRPC route (Service appProtocol h2c) reaches it as HTTP/2.

The Gateway translates grpc-web (HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2) on the gRPC hostname into native gRPC; a signed grpc-web publication reached the fixture and changed owner state (status 200; grpc-status was not surfaced in response headers).

Raw HTTP/1.1 header names keep case-insensitive matching, padding is trimmed, comma values are kept, duplicates stay separate, and header names containing underscores (x_ec00_underscore) are forwarded unchanged. A backend that maps '_' to '-' (WSGI/CGI) could therefore see a second identity or correlation header; production ingress or backends must reject or drop underscore header names.

Latency (client wall time, reused connection, n=20, first request excluded): HTTP v2 signed publication p50 9.28 / p95 14.53 ms; gRPC 11.45 / 14.46 ms; Connect JSON 55.81 / 59.97 ms; Connect binary 55.66 / 60.26 ms. The ~45 ms Connect floor is already present over local loopback (uvicorn/HTTP/1.1 path) and is not attributed to the Gateway. No cross-candidate performance claim is made from this sample.
not_qualified: production gateway/bootstrap or real identity issuance
